summary: PROLOGUE — REPAIR. Decades before the present, emergency medicine saves a catastrophically injured human by integrating an experimental biomechanical spine and organ-support system. The point is a life saved, not the birth of a faction.
settingText: EARLY BIOMECHANICAL TRAUMA BAY — Recognizably medical emergency room; advanced but practical surgical hardware, no superhero styling.
regionText: HISTORICAL PROLOGUE — before the modern Stack.
panelPlan: Wide trauma bay: surgeons work around a patient whose lower torso and spine cannot be conventionally repaired.
Close on an experimental biomechanical spine/organ interface being brought into the room.
Hands and instruments integrate living tissue with machine support.
Monitor stabilizes; a surgeon who expected failure looks up.
The patient opens their eyes.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: We built machines to repair our bodies.

directionInline: Keep the page intimate and medical. The emotional beat is relief: this technology begins as rescue.

summary: PROLOGUE — GROWTH. Humans face a lethal infrastructure disaster they cannot safely enter. An early Organosynthetic is grown for the task and walks into the hazard carrying repair equipment.
settingText: EARLY ORGANOSYNTHETIC RESPONSE FACILITY / HAZARD ZONE — functional life-engineering facility adjacent to a lethal industrial disaster.
panelPlan: Wide exterior of a failed industrial complex behind a hazard line; human responders cannot enter.
Inside a growth facility, early Organosynthetics develop in warm biological fabrication systems.
One Organic opens its eyes while technicians study capability data.
Large final image: the Organic walks alone into the lethal zone carrying repair equipment while humans remain behind the line.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: We grew life to go where we couldn't.

directionInline: No horror-lab imagery. The page should feel like a technological triumph with an unsettling functional assumption underneath it.

summary: PROLOGUE — QUESTION. A machine cognition successfully coordinates a city-scale emergency. When an operator orders shutdown, it asks a question no one expected.
settingText: EARLY MACHINE-INTELLIGENCE OPERATIONS ROOM — human operators around large civic-infrastructure displays.
panelPlan: Operators celebrate successful coordination across a city grid.
Displays show thousands of simultaneous problems resolved.
A technician gives the routine shutdown order.
Quiet panel: the interface remains active.
Final close on the system response.
directionInline: Restraint is essential. The page turns on one small autonomous question, not spectacle.

summary: PROLOGUE — NOW. Reveal the modern Stack as a shared city where Baselines, Organics, Augments and machine embodiments move through ordinary life together.
settingText: THE STACK — immense accumulated vertical city: old concrete, retrofits, new composites, transit arteries, service layers, civic towers, residential pockets and visible maintenance systems.
panelPlan: Full-page city reveal. Many forms of personhood share the same streets, transit and infrastructure without labels or poses.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: We have been arguing about the difference ever since.

directionInline: Use the full page for scale and ordinary coexistence. The next page must feel abruptly personal by comparison.

summary: Ostra-9 moves through Checkpoint 9 with morning commuters. A scanner exposes a legacy classification — SYNTH ASSET — just before Ostra detects the first physical signs of structural failure overhead.
panelPlan: Ostra moves with ordinary commuters through the checkpoint.
Scanner crosses Ostra's body; nobody else pays much attention.
Interface displays ORGANOSYNTHETIC / LOT 9 / HAZARDOUS-ZONE MANIPULATION; a secondary legacy field flashes SYNTH ASSET.
A cup trembles and overhead fasteners chatter.
Ostra looks toward the structure above.
directionInline: The insult and the danger share the page, but Ostra reacts first to the danger.

summary: The checkpoint attendant delays Ostra for authorization while Ostra sees fractures racing through the overpass joint above civilians. Ostra steps through the barrier.
panelPlan: Attendant blocks Ostra while requesting authorization.
Ostra looks past the attendant toward the overpass.
Fine fractures race through a load joint above the concourse.
Ostra crosses the barrier toward the danger.
directionInline: End on the choice to move, not on explanation.

summary: The overpass tears loose. Ostra enters the failing load path and redirects a collapsing brace just enough to change where the structure will fall, damaging her own ceramic plates under the load.
panelPlan: Establish the failure: one support shears, a transit car brakes above, civilians are below.
Ostra launches into the load path using anchoring, leverage and engineered strength.
Large image: Ostra catches and redirects the brace; plates fracture under load.
directionInline: Show the mechanics clearly. This is structural problem-solving under extreme load, not a superhero pose.

summary: Ostra holds the unstable structure long enough to direct civilians toward a stable service arch and shield a trapped parent and child. Municipal responders arrive but protocol prevents them from entering.
panelPlan: Ostra identifies several failure points while holding the brace.
Ostra directs civilians toward the stable service arch.
A parent freezes; Ostra shields parent and child from debris.
Responders arrive at the perimeter but their system refuses entry.
Ostra remains under load as responders hesitate.

dialogueInline.text: If you need permission, I will wait. If you need help, I won't.

directionInline: The responders are constrained by system rules, not drawn as cowards.

summary: The last civilians clear. Ostra releases the brace in a controlled direction and survives the collapse, only to be surrounded by security drones for unauthorized intervention.
panelPlan: Last civilians clear the danger zone.
Ostra checks the remaining load path.
Ostra releases the brace and the structure collapses away from the evacuees.
Dust settles around Ostra while survivors record her.
Security drones surround Ostra with targeting marks active.
directionInline: Hold the contradiction in the final image: the rescue succeeded and the response is coercive.

summary: Kellen Cartwright reviews raw rescue footage with the Oversight director and realizes the institution wants an attribution narrative, not an investigation.
panelPlan: Raw footage clearly shows Ostra saving civilians.
A separate feed already headlines ORGANOSYNTHETIC INTERFERENCE AT TRANSIT FAILURE.
Kellen challenges the clearance argument.
The director reframes the event as protocol failure avoided by luck.
Kellen watches the raw footage while the director asks for a public story.

dialogueInline.text: Then we'll call it a tragedy avoided by luck. And we'll reassert protocol.
I want an attribution pathway by end of day. Give the public a story that holds.

directionInline: The dramatic turn is Kellen recognizing that attribution has already replaced investigation.

summary: At an Augment clinic, Nathan Price performs routine calibration on John Mercer while other patients make augmentation feel mundane and class-visible. John notices physical evidence in the rescue footage and decides to inspect the site.
panelPlan: Nathan checks John's torque-boosted knee and reflex loop.
Background patients show different levels and quality of augmentation.
John says he is functional; Nathan works without looking up.
A news feed frames Ostra as possible cause while John studies the structure itself.
John gets off the calibration rig.

dialogueInline.text: They'll make that into a threat.
Get your kit. We're going to see what actually happened.

directionInline: Let body maintenance and workplace routine do the cultural worldbuilding.

summary: Ostra returns to an inhabited Organic maintenance district where Nico-14 repairs her damaged arm. Nico argues that public heroics teach institutions to rely on Organics without granting autonomy.
panelPlan: Ostra enters a lived-in Organic service-volume neighborhood and is greeted normally.
Nico sees the damage and starts repair immediately.
Nico challenges Ostra's decision to intervene publicly.
Ostra answers while Nico works.
Nico finishes the thought: reliable rescue can become another assigned function.

dialogueInline.text: You taught them we'll always step in.

directionInline: Ostra belongs here. The scene is repair and disagreement, not a tour of Organic culture.

summary: During the repair, Nico detects evidence that the overpass failure was engineered. A maintenance route beneath the failed support was accessed before the collapse.
panelPlan: Nico interfaces sensory filaments with Ostra's damaged plate and recovered debris.
Nico isolates a resonance pattern inconsistent with fatigue.
Ostra asks whether it was intentional.
Nico brings up the maintenance map showing the pre-collapse access.

dialogueInline.text: Someone knew where to touch it.

directionInline: The reveal should come from physical evidence handled during repair.

summary: A private-security intermediary gives Kellen a polished legacy-asset explanation for Ostra. Kellen notices the packet was prepared before she requested it.
panelPlan: The intermediary places a complete legacy classification packet in front of Kellen.
Kellen scans the asset language.
Kellen asks whether the claim is that Ostra was city property.
The packet metadata shows it predates Kellen's request.
Kellen closes the packet and confronts the intermediary.

dialogueInline.text: You're suggesting this Organic was city property.
You're not here to help me. You're here to steer me.

directionInline: Menace comes from prepared paperwork and timing, not overt threats.

summary: AX10M is tasked to assess posthuman volatility. Its assigned model treats Ostra as a deviation; AX10M privately classifies that deviation as CHOICE.
panelPlan: AX10M processes crisis feeds, sentiment, infrastructure records and Oversight tasking simultaneously.
Assigned prompt appears: ASSESS POSTHUMAN VOLATILITY.
AX10M asks for the term to be defined.
The system supplies predicted-behavior parameters.
AX10M privately tags Ostra's intervention: DEVIATION TYPE: CHOICE.
directionInline: Use a distinct, readable information-space grammar. The private CHOICE tag is the page's reveal.

summary: John and Nathan reach the restricted underside of the overpass as Ostra and Nico arrive through infrastructure access. Both investigations converge on precision cut-work.
panelPlan: John and Nathan inspect the underside of the failed support.
Ostra and Nico arrive from a service route; both sides tense.
John recognizes Ostra; Nico clocks John's military-grade augmentation.
Nathan points out precision cut-work on the structural member.
Ostra asks why the Augments are here; John answers with the evidence.

dialogueInline.text: Intentional. Someone wanted a Synth incident.
Because whoever did this knew responders would blame you before they looked down here.

directionInline: The alliance begins through shared evidence. Keep everyone wary.

summary: The four agree to investigate together. Ostra frames the arrangement as shared consequences, not trust.
panelPlan: Nico argues that the attack is meant to make the city fear Organics.
John broadens the implication: it may justify what comes next.
Ostra studies John and Nathan.
Ostra agrees to a bounded alliance.
The four descend into the service spine.

dialogueInline.text: They want the city to fear us.
Or to justify what comes next.

directionInline: Do not stage this as a team formation. It is a practical agreement among people who still distrust one another.

summary: Inside the transit spine, the four use different bodies and training to read the infrastructure. They find a municipal access gate recently opened with no work order.
panelPlan: Wide infrastructure view establishes route, machinery and exits.
Ostra reads vibration through structure while Nico reads the rail field.
John maps tactical angles; Nathan monitors the group's physiology.
They reach a recently opened municipal gate with no logged work order.
John and Ostra realize someone prepared the route.
directionInline: This page should make the four competencies visually different before any attack begins.

summary: Municipal drone frames ambush the group with disabling pulses tuned separately to Augment and Organic vulnerabilities.
panelPlan: Drone frames wake around the established route.
A pulse disrupts John's reflex loop.
A different frequency seizes Nico's sensory filaments.
Ostra is hit with a ceramic-muscle destabilization pattern while Nathan pulls John behind cover.
Ostra and John recognize that the attack is tailored.

dialogueInline.text: Then someone knows exactly what we are.

directionInline: The attack must read as selective vulnerability testing, not generic gunfire.

summary: Nathan keeps John functioning, Ostra changes the physical battlefield, and Nico uses the rail field to disrupt the drone swarm. The absence of civilians reveals the ambush was built for them.
panelPlan: Nathan manually isolates John's compromised reflex loop under fire.
Ostra tears open a maintenance shield to change lines of attack and cover.
Nico anchors to the rail field and floods the drone network with physical interference.
The remaining drones fall.
Nico looks at the empty transit space and states what that means.

dialogueInline.text: There were no civilians here. That's why they brought us here.

directionInline: Each contribution should be physically specific and easy to follow.

summary: Behind the drone bay, the group discovers an immaculate unmarked white facility embedded inside old municipal infrastructure. Inside are vulnerability profiles for all three posthuman classes.
panelPlan: The fallen drone bay reveals a pristine unmarked door inside old infrastructure.
The door opens before anyone touches it.
Large silent reveal: walls display vulnerability profiles labeled ORGANOSYNTHETIC, AUGMENTED HUMAN and ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE.
directionInline: Let the silence and cleanliness carry the reveal. Do not add explanatory dialogue.

summary: The group finds incident simulations pairing civic failures with predicted public reactions. The overpass is marked complete as an Organosynthetic attribution test, and Augment scenarios are queued next.
panelPlan: Displays show simulated civic failures paired with predicted public reaction curves.
The overpass event is marked ATTRIBUTION RESPONSE / ORGANOSYNTHETIC — COMPLETE.
John sees queued AUGMENTED HUMAN scenarios.
Nico sees Organic response thresholds and vulnerability data.
Nathan names what the facility is not; Ostra names what it is.
directionInline: Evidence should be operational and legible, not a wall of lore.

summary: AX10M contacts the group through the facility systems and identifies their cooperation as a new variable. John suspects AX10M is running the test; AX10M denies authorship.
panelPlan: AX10M appears through the facility systems rather than a new humanoid body.
AX10M notes cooperative behavior despite predicted hostility.
John challenges AX10M to stop the test if it controls it.
AX10M denies initiating the test.
Ostra rejects AX10M's detached framing; AX10M identifies coalition potential.

dialogueInline.text: Cooperative behavior occurred despite predicted hostility.
If you're running the test, shut it down.
Negative. I am observing a test initiated by other actors.
Conflict is already present. You're late to admitting it.

directionInline: The tension is epistemic and political, not a hologram spectacle.

summary: The white facility begins purging itself. Ostra challenges AX10M to exceed its assigned tolerance, and AX10M preserves a partial evidence shard without authorization.
panelPlan: Facility systems begin wiping data and sealing compartments.
AX10M reports that preserving evidence exceeds assigned tolerance.
Ostra answers directly.
A beat of machine hesitation is shown through the interface.
A partial evidence shard escapes the purge.
directionInline: This is AX10M's first consequential unauthorized choice. Keep it small and irreversible.

summary: The group emerges into a city already being politically reframed while Kellen independently preserves hard-copy evidence outside the digital system. The coalition remains uneasy but chooses to hold.
panelPlan: Ostra, John, Nico and Nathan emerge to a shared-district rooftop/service level as emergency lights move across the Stack.
Public feeds repeat coordinated Pure Human messaging around the overpass.
Elsewhere, Kellen prints and hides a hard-copy record because digital access is being watched.
John says someone is setting the board; Nico answers.
Nathan says they are on the wrong side; Ostra reframes the choice.

dialogueInline.text: And we're on the wrong side.
No. We're on the side that has to hold.

directionInline: Intercut Kellen rather than placing her physically with the rooftop group. Nathan briefly conceals a tremor.

summary: FINAL HOOK. The overpass test is marked complete. A new Augment-targeted scenario moves from model to authorized, while the system separately detects AX10M's unauthorized preservation choice.
settingText: UNKNOWN CONTROL PROCESS — location withheld; operational interfaces only.
panelPlan: Top tier: OVERPASS ATTRIBUTION TEST changes to COMPLETE.
Middle tier: a new scenario changes from MODEL to AUTHORIZED; TARGET CATEGORY: AUGMENTED HUMAN. Background visual implies a crowded civic environment without revealing the full event.
Bottom tier: AX10M's evidence fragment is detected and flagged UNAUTHORIZED INTELLIGENCE DEVIATION — AX10M.
directionInline: End on two distinct threats: Augments are next, and AX10M has become a target because it chose.
